title: Post Pancreatitis Complications Study (Based on a Prospective Data Base)
brief_summary: The purpose of this observational epidemiological study is to investigate the management and the complications associated with pancreatitis. Datas will be analysed to answer pre-defined scientific projects and to improve management of these conditions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pancreatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* consent withdrawal
study_population: Patients with pancreatitis hospitalized in ICU
